values.value: On this day in 2015, Canada's Truth and Reconciliation Commission released its full final report on residential schools. Its 94 calls to action had come out that June. It documented the deaths of at least 3,200 children in the schools, and the commission's chair said the real number was likely much higher. Call to action 80 asked for a national day to honour survivors. Since 2021, that day has been September 30.
the Truth and Reconciliation Commission released its final report
